claims.content: The Operator logs into the system via the GUI and, upon successful authentication and authorization, acquires command control to issue commands that monitor and control system devices and status.

goal.raw_text: The Operator logs into the system via the GUI and, upon successful authentication and authorization, acquires command control to issue commands that monitor and control system devices and status.

claims.content: Operator
The Operator must have a valid user name and corresponding password to authenticate via the logon screen.
The Operator must have authorization to activate command control.
Command control shall be accessed from only specified workstations.
If command control is already enabled by another user, the logging-in Operator must be of higher security level and accept or deny command control transfer.
The Operator requests command control on the logon screen and has authorization.

trigger.raw_text: The Operator requests command control on the logon screen and has authorization.

claims.content: The Operator logs into the system via the GUI logon screen which requests a user name and corresponding password.
Upon successful authentication, if the Operator requests command control and has authorization, the logon screen activates command control for the user.
The system verifies that command control is being accessed from a specified workstation.
If command control is already enabled by another user and the logging-in Operator has a higher security level, the system requests the Operator to accept or deny the command control transfer.
If the new Operator takes command control from another user, the other user is notified.

If the TMC workstations or network server fails, resulting in loss of field status at the TMC, alternate control shall be at FCU South or FCU North, where the operator dials in from a back up computer.
If FCU North or South fails, alternate control is established at the non-failed FCU (North or South).

If FCUs North and South both fail, alternate control units are direct control at DCUs 1-5 and CMS 1-12 control from CMS cabinets, where the operator connects a laptop computer at the DCUs or CMS cabinet.
If any DCU 1-5 fails, alternate control is performed via the MCU and manual control at the field devices.
If any MCU fails, alternate control is manual control at the field devices related to the failed MCU, operated from their cabinets.
The Operator is logged onto the system and has activated command control.
The GUI displays the current date and time, user's name, and workstation location name.
If command control was taken from another user, that other user has been notified.
